getRes:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Scans pairs of points to detect impossible same-direction or duplicate gaps, returning 'IMPOSSIBLE' when detected, and otherwise computing two consecutive integers that define the separating configuration." getRes] [INPUTS] n : int "Number of points from paris to process." paris : List

"List of P objects, each with integer fields a and b." [END_INPUTS] [OUTPUTS] return_value : String "Either the string 'IMPOSSIBLE' or a string 'x y' containing two consecutive integers." [END_OUTPUTS] [MAIN_FLOW] [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK] [COMMAND Initialize pfracs and nfracs as empty TreeSet collections and hasDup as false. RESULT pfracs_nfracs_hasDup] [COMMAND For each i from 0 to n-1, retrieve p1 = paris.get(i); for each j from i+1 to n-1, retrieve p2 = paris.get(j) and compute d1 = p1.a - p2.a and d2 = p1.b - p2.b. If d1 == 0 && d2 == 0 or d1 > 0 && d2 > 0, set hasDup = true and break the inner loop. Otherwise, if d1 != 0 && d2 != 0 && (d1 > 0 || d2 > 0), add new F(Math.abs(d1), Math.abs(d2)) to pfracs when d1 < 0 and to nfracs when d2 < 0. If both d1 and d2 are negative, do nothing. After the inner loop, break the outer loop if hasDup is true. RESULT pair_scan_state] [COMMAND Set above to pfracs.isEmpty() ? null : pfracs.first() and below to nfracs.isEmpty() ? null : nfracs.last(). RESULT above_below] [COMMAND Check the ordering guard: if above != null && below != null && above.compareTo(below) <= 0, follow the alternative path that returns "IMPOSSIBLE"; otherwise continue with the final computation. RESULT ordering_guard] [COMMAND With above != null, below != null, and above.compareTo(below) > 0, compute gcd = gcd(above.denum, below.denum); b2 = above.denum / gcd; lcd = below.denum * b2; a = above.num * (lcd / above.denum); b = below.num * (lcd / below.denum); z = a - b; r = 2 * lcd. RESULT scaled_values] [COMMAND Compute x as the ceiling of r / z: if r % z == 0 then set x = r / z, otherwise set x = r / z + 1. RESULT x] [COMMAND Return the string formed by x concatenated with a space and x + 1. RESULT returned_string] [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK] [END_MAIN_FLOW] [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: hasDup is true after the pairwise scan.] [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK] [COMMAND Return the string "IMPOSSIBLE". RESULT returned_string] [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK] [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW] [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: above != null && below != null && above.compareTo(below) <= 0, evaluated with short-circuit logic.] [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK] [COMMAND Return the string "IMPOSSIBLE". RESULT returned_string] [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK] [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW] [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: above == null && below == null.] [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK] [COMMAND Return the string "1 1". RESULT returned_string] [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK] [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW] [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: above == null && below != null.] [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK] [COMMAND Set z = below.num, r = below.denum, and y = 0. If r % z == 0 then set y = r / z, otherwise set y = r / z + 1. RESULT y] [COMMAND Return the string formed by "1 " concatenated with y + 1. RESULT returned_string] [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK] [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW] [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: below == null && above != null.] [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK] [COMMAND Set z = above.num, r = above.denum, and x = 0. If r % z == 0 then set x = r / z, otherwise set x = r / z + 1. RESULT x] [COMMAND Return the string formed by x + 1 concatenated with " 1". RESULT returned_string] [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK] [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW] [END_WORKER]
